s02.text: Hoje você monta este jogo no mesmo circuito. E seu melhor tempo fica salvo, mesmo sem energia.
s02.en: Today you'll build this reflex game, on the same circuit. And your best time stays saved, even when you unplug the board.

s13.text: É o ticket de estacionamento. No verde, goTo() anota a hora. Ao apertar, agora menos essa hora é a reação.
s13.en: It's the parking ticket. When green comes on, go to writes down the time. When you press, now minus that moment is your reaction.

s33.text: Pense na sua mesa. Variáveis são caixas nela, e sem energia a mesa é limpa. Mas o caderno na gaveta fica.
s33.en: Think of your desk. Variables are labeled boxes on the desk, and a power cut clears the whole desk. But a notebook in the drawer stays.

s40.text: No passo três: se a reação vence best, guardamos em best, e putULong() grava na gaveta.
s40.en: And in step three: if the reaction beats best, we put the new record into best, and put writes it into the drawer.

s47.text: Uma forma: variáveis vivem em memória que precisa de energia. A gaveta é flash, que não precisa.
s47.en: One way to say it: variables live in memory that needs power. The drawer is flash memory, which keeps its contents without power.

s51.text: Precisa de mais um passo e mais uma checagem. A solução está na pasta, e mostro num Short.
s51.en: You need one more step number and one more check. The solution is in the lesson folder, and I'll show it in a Short.

s09.text: Color LED नतीजा दिखाती है: तेज़ तो हरी, ठीक तो पीली, धीमा तो लाल। knob पीली का इंतज़ार बदलता है, गिनती काम नहीं करेगी।
s09.en: The color LED shows how you did: green for fast, yellow for okay, and red for slow. And the knob sets how long the yellow waits, so you can't just count.

s13.text: पार्किंग टिकट। हरी जलते ही goTo() समय लिखता है। दबाने पर अभी का समय घटाइए: वही reaction है।
s13.en: It's the parking ticket. When green comes on, go to writes down the time. When you press, now minus that moment is your reaction.

s16.text: Helpers पुराने दोस्त हैं: setColor() नतीजे की बत्ती, lights() तीन LED, goTo() आगे बढ़ने को।
s16.en: The helpers are old friends too: set color for the result light, lights for the three LEDs, and go to for moving on.

s20.text: कदम शून्य उस press का इंतज़ार करता है। फिर लाल जलती है, और कदम एक।
s20.en: Step zero waits for that press. Then red comes on, and we go to step one.

s26.text: कदम चार वो रंग तीन सेकंड दिखाता है, फिर अगले round के लिए कदम शून्य।
s26.en: Step four shows that color for three seconds, then goes back to step zero for the next round.

s30.text: हरी पाना कठिन हो जाता है। सिर्फ़ बहुत तेज़ press चलती है, ज़्यादा round पीले पर ख़त्म।
s30.en: Green gets harder to earn. Only really fast presses count now, and more of your rounds end yellow.

s39.text: क्योंकि असली reaction उससे छोटा होता है। पहला round हमेशा रिकॉर्ड बनता है।
s39.en: Because any real reaction is smaller. So your very first round always becomes the record.

s40.text: कदम तीन में: reaction best से बेहतर हो तो best में डालते हैं, और putULong() दराज़ में लिखता है।
s40.en: And in step three: if the reaction beats best, we put the new record into best, and put writes it into the drawer.

s43.text: अब एक आम ग़लती। कोई नतीजा सहेजना चाहता है, तो हर round के बाद put लिखता है, if के बिना।
s43.en: Now a mistake you might make. Someone wants to save the result, so they write put after every round, without the if.

s45.text: मिट गया। धीमा समय उस पर लिख गया। if ही उसे रिकॉर्ड बनाता है: दराज़ में सिर्फ़ बेहतर समय जाता है।
s45.en: It's gone. The slow time is written over it. The if is what makes it a record: only a better time goes into the drawer.

s47.text: ऐसे कह सकते हैं: variables को बिजली वाली memory चाहिए। दराज़ flash memory है, जो बिना बिजली रखती है।
s47.en: One way to say it: variables live in memory that needs power. The drawer is flash memory, which keeps its contents without power.

s50.text: आपकी बारी, ग़लत शुरुआत: लाल या पीली में press हो तो color LED लाल चमके, और समय न गिना जाए।
s50.en: Your turn, the project homework: a false start. A press during red or yellow flashes the color LED red, and no time counts.

s51.text: एक और कदम नंबर और एक और जाँच चाहिए। हल lesson folder में है, और Short में दिखाऊँगा।
s51.en: You need one more step number and one more check. The solution is in the lesson folder, and I'll show it in a Short.

s53.text: अगली बार: पाँचवें episode से अब तक का recap, quiz के साथ। अपना बेस्ट reaction time comments में बताइए। मिलते हैं!
s53.en: Next time, a recap of everything since episode five, with a quiz. Tell me your best reaction time in the comments. See you there!

s10.text: Otra vez, ningún cable nuevo. Es el circuito del cruce.
s10.en: And again, not a single new wire. It's exactly the circuit from the crossing.

s14.text: Así, el tiempo en el paso verde es tu reacción. Sin código nuevo.
s14.en: So the time you spent in the green step is your reaction time. No new code needed for that.

s16.text: Helpers conocidos: setColor() para el resultado, lights() para los LEDs, goTo() para avanzar.
s16.en: The helpers are old friends too: set color for the result light, lights for the three LEDs, and go to for moving on.

s24.text: El paso tres es el corazón. Con pressed, el tiempo del paso es la reacción, y el Monitor la muestra.
s24.en: Step three is the heart of the game. When pressed comes, the time in this step is the reaction, and the Serial Monitor prints it.

s33.text: Piensa en tu escritorio. Las variables son cajas encima, y sin energía se limpia. El cuaderno del cajón queda.
s33.en: Think of your desk. Variables are labeled boxes on the desk, and a power cut clears the whole desk. But a notebook in the drawer stays.

s35.text: La diferencia: el cajón es pequeño y cada escritura lo desgasta un poco. Solo escribimos lo que vale la pena.
s35.en: The difference from a real notebook: this drawer is small, and every write wears it a little. So we write only when something worth keeping happens.

s37.text: Luego getULong() lee la página best. Si está vacía, devuelve el segundo número: nueve nueve nueve nueve.
s37.en: Then get reads the page called best. If the page is still empty, it gives back the number in the second slot, here nine nine nine nine.

s51.text: Necesitas un paso más y una revisión más. La solución está en la carpeta, y en un Short.
s51.en: You need one more step number and one more check. The solution is in the lesson folder, and I'll show it in a Short.
